subject: Equinox: VPC bundle options & support credit request
messages:
From: Alex Dunn <alex.dunn@equinox.ai>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.ai>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@equinox.ai>
Date: 2026-07-19T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: VPC packaging options and commercial asks

Hi Naomi,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the team at Equinox is excited about Redwood's runtime performance. Procurement asked me to pull together a few commercial questions so we can decide on a deployment path. High level: we expect to run latency-sensitive customer-facing workloads (peak ~120 tokens/sec aggregate, ~40 concurrent sessions) and want to deploy in our AWS account (us-west-2).

Can you provide options for private deployments (VPC/on-prem) that show:
- Pricing for a dedicated site license vs per-GPU/node licensing
- How the platform fee would be amortized against a 24-month commit
- Support tier pricing (Standard vs Premium 24/7 SRE) and a menu of included vs add-on services
- Any migration/onboarding credit you can offer for a pilot (we have ~6TB of models & data to transfer)

Budget is tight for CY26. If we can get a reasonable platform fee amortized and a migration credit, procurement can move quickly. Attaching our internal requirements doc.

Regards,
Alex Dunn
Director of ML Ops
Equinox AI

Attachment: equinox_requirements_v2.pdf

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Dunn <alex.dunn@equinox.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-07-19T12:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: VPC packaging options and commercial asks

Alex — thanks for the clear ask and the requirements doc. High level we can present three distinct packaging options; I summarized below and attached a line-item workbook. Ben, adding you for the technical sizing note.

Option A (Starter Site) — 12-month pilot path
- Pricing: Per-node licensing + consumption for burst (no large platform fee up front)
- Platform fee: $0 for first 12 months, then optional annual platform fee if we convert
- Support: Standard (business hours + ticket SLAs) included
- Migration credit: $25,000 one-time credit toward onboarding

Option B (Balanced Commit) — 24-month preferred
- Pricing: Site license covering up to 4 dedicated nodes ($/node included in site price)
- Platform fee: $120,000/year amortized across the contract (we can apply as credit across invoices)
- Support: Premium optional at +$90,000/year (24/7 SRE retainer)
- Migration credit: $50,000 one-time credit if signed within 30 days

Option C (Enterprise Committed) — 36-month, volume focused
- Pricing: Blended site license with per-GPU uplift for additional nodes
- Platform fee: $95,000/year amortized
- Support: Premium included for first 12 months; discounted renewal thereafter
- Migration credit: $75,000 + implementation assistance (SRE hours)

Notes:
- Platform fee amortization: we can either invoice monthly or apply as prepaid credit to reduce monthly line items.
- Add-ons: audit logging retention beyond 12 months and HSM/KMS integration are separate line items in the workbook.

Attached: equinox_vpc_pricing_breakdown.xlsx (line-item workup), technical_node_readme.pdf (Ben's sizing guidance).

If you can confirm target node count and willingness to commit 24 months, I can circulate a draft SOW and commercial term sheet.

Best,
Naomi Feldman
Head of Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference

Attachments: equinox_vpc_pricing_breakdown.xlsx, technical_node_readme.pdf

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Dunn <alex.dunn@equinox.ai>, Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-07-19T14:18:00-07:00
Subject: Re: VPC packaging options and commercial asks — sizing note

Alex — quick technical note to help with node counts. Based on your described burst and session pattern, the conservative recommendation is:
- 4 x A100-equivalent nodes for steady-state (handles KV cache + concurrent sessions)
- Burst pool: ability to elastically add 1–2 spot/ephemeral nodes for spikes

Two things that materially change price: model sequence length and whether you enable full KV caching across requests. If you want the lower platform fee path, we can reduce the effective node count by enabling passport-level prefix caching and a 2-week warm cache period during onboarding (we'll need runbook access to set initial cache policy).

Attachment: technical_node_readme.pdf

Cheers,
Ben Carter
Principal Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference

From: Alex Dunn <alex.dunn@equinox.ai>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.ai>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@equinox.ai>
Date: 2026-07-20T08:46:00-07:00
Subject: Re: VPC packaging options and commercial asks

Thanks Naomi and Ben — that helps. A few follow-ups from procurement:
- Equinox preference is Option B (24-month commit) but we need better amortization terms for the platform fee. Our finance target is ~$150k total platform spend/year (including amortized fees) for CY27.
- For migration support, can you stretch to $75k credit if we sign within 21 days and provide a modest reference?
- Premium support priced at +$90k/year is OK, but procurement is asking for at least a 10% discount.

We can target 4 dedicated nodes as Ben suggested. Procurement contact (Cc) will be preparing a PO template if we reach an agreement. Please confirm final commercial terms and I can loop legal.

—Alex

Procurement reply (inline):
> We will start a PO hold once commercial terms are signed. Please also include a 30-day SLA exception for initial onboarding to allow for migration windows.

Alex Dunn
Director of ML Ops, Equinox AI

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Dunn <alex.dunn@equinox.ai>
Cc: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-07-21T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: VPC packaging options and commercial asks — commercial counter

Alex — appreciate the clarity. We can do a commercial counter close to what you asked; outline below is conditional on a 24-month signature within 21 days and an Equinox public reference/brief case study after go-live.

Counter (Option B, revised):
- Platform fee: $120,000/year amortized (applied as a credit across invoices)
- Migration/onboarding credit: $50,000 one-time credit applied to implementation invoice
- Premium support: base $90,000/year with a 15% discount (so $76,500/year) if you take premium for the duration of the 24-month term
- Payment terms: Net 30; we can split the first year platform fee across 3 quarterly invoices to ease cashflow
- SLA: we can accept a 30-day onboarding exception window as requested; production SLA applies after onboarding sign-off

Additional commercial sweetener: we can include 40 hours of SRE assistance during migration (booked in the first 90 days) and a one-time performance tuning session post go-live.

If that is acceptable, Naomi will circulate a term sheet and a draft SOW and we can get DocuSign started.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Director, Customer Success & Commercials, Redwood Inference

Attachment: 20260721_EQUINOX_terms_summary.pdf

From: Alex Dunn <alex.dunn@equinox.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.ai>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@equinox.ai>
Date: 2026-07-22T15:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: VPC packaging options and commercial asks — acceptance in principle

Marissa / Naomi — thanks, we can accept that counter in principle. Two final asks before I route to legal:
1) Please include the exact DocuSign link to the term sheet + SOW so procurement can validate fields before signature.
2) Confirm that the $50k migration credit is non-refundable and applied to the implementation invoice; also confirm the 40 SRE hours are not billable beyond the initial 90-day window unless we request additional support.

Procurement note: once we have the DocuSign package and a final SOW, we'll prepare the PO and aim to issue within 5 business days.

Will await the DocuSign and SOW.

Regards,
Alex Dunn
Director of ML Ops, Equinox AI

--- End of thread ---
